scripts.text:
import os, json, urllib.request

req = urllib.request.Request("https://monitor.example.com/api/v1/checks",
                             headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["MONITOR_TOKEN"]})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
    checks = json.load(r)
for c in checks:
    print(c["name"], c["status"])

#!/bin/bash
set -e
# redeploy the web stack
curl -sf -X POST https://komodo.example.com/execute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KOMODO_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"type":"DeployStack","params":{"stack":"web"}}'
echo deployed

import os, pathlib, urllib.request
BASE = "https://photos.example.com/api/assets"
for p in pathlib.Path("incoming").glob("*.jpg"):
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE, data=p.read_bytes(), method="POST",
                                 headers={"x-api-key": os.environ["PHOTOS_KEY"], "Content-Type": "image/jpeg"})
    urllib.request.urlopen(req)
    print("uploaded", p.name)

#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p export
for uid in $(curl -sf -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAFANA_TOKEN" https://grafana.example.com/api/search | jq -r '.[].uid'); do
  curl -sf -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAFANA_TOKEN" https://grafana.example.com/api/dashboards/uid/$uid > export/$uid.json
done
